welcome.title: Ubufasha bwa buri munsi nyuma ya stroke
welcome.lead: Kurikiza gahunda yawe yo gukira, ukurikirane umuvuduko w'amaraso n'imiti, kandi ubisangize abagufasha.
welcome.safety: StrokeCare ibika ibyo wanditse. Ntisuzuma indwara, ntitanga imiti kandi ntisimbura ubutabazi bwihutirwa.

roles.survivorHint: Ndimo gukira ndi mu rugo nyuma ya stroke
roles.preventionHint: Nita ku buzima bwanjye kugira ngo nirinde stroke

consent.title: Mbere yo gutangira
consent.draft: Aya matangazo ni ay'agateganyo. Inyandiko ya nyuma y'amategeko ntiranditswe.

privacy_notice.title: Itangazo ry'ibanga
privacy_notice.body: Tubika amakuru ya konti yawe kugira ngo porogaramu ikore. Ushobora gukuramo cyangwa gusiba byose igihe icyo ari cyo cyose muri Njye.

health_data.title: Amakuru y'ubuzima bwawe
health_data.body: Tubika ibipimo, ibisubizo n'inyandiko wanditse. Ni wowe gusa n'abo uhitamo kubisangiza bashobora kubibona. Igihe cyose undi muntu abifunguye, birandikwa.
health_data.agree: Nemeye ko amakuru y'ubuzima bwanjye abikwa kandi agakoreshwa

today.unread: Ubutumwa bushya {n} buvuye ku itsinda rikwitaho

checkin.title: Ikurikirana rya buri munsi
checkin.lead: Ushobora gusimbuka ikibazo icyo ari cyo cyose.
checkin.leadOther: Subiza mu izina ry'uwo witaho. Buri kibazo gishobora gusimbukwa.
checkin.oneScreen: Subiza ibyo ushaka ureke ibindi. Ibisigaye ubusa byoherezwa nk'ibyasimbutswe.

emergency.title: Ubutabazi bwihutirwa
emergency.message: Niba utekereza ko wowe cyangwa undi muntu uri hafi yawe ashobora kuba afite stroke cyangwa ikindi kibazo cyihutirwa, hamagara serivisi z'ubutabazi zo mu gace kawe ubu nonaha. Ntutegereze iyi porogaramu.
emergency.fallback: Niba utekereza ko wowe cyangwa undi muntu uri hafi yawe ashobora kuba afite stroke cyangwa ikindi kibazo cyihutirwa, hamagara serivisi z'ubutabazi zo mu gace kawe ubu nonaha. Ntutegereze iyi porogaramu.
emergency.noVerified: Nta nimero yemejwe iraboneka mu gace kawe. Hamagara serivisi z'ubutabazi zo mu gace kawe nk'uko usanzwe ubigenza.

bp.title: Umuvuduko w'amaraso
bp.hint: Andika imibare igaragazwa n'igikoresho gipima umuvuduko w'amaraso. Igipimo: mmHg.
bp.topAboveBottom: Umubare wo hejuru ugomba kuruta uwo hasi. Ongera urebe.

meds.title: Imiti
meds.summary: Imiti {n} kuri {total} yanditswe ko yafashwe uyu munsi
meds.undo: Byanditswe ko wawufashe. Kanda ngo ubihindure.
meds.onlyClinician: Umuganga wawe ni we wenyine ushobora guhindura uru rutonde. Niba hari ikitameze neza, cyandike muri
meds.courseFromTo: Kuva ku wa {from} kugeza ku wa {to}
meds.courseFrom: Guhera ku wa {from}, nta tariki yo kurangiriraho
meds.allDone: Imiti yose y'uyu munsi yashyizweho ko yafashwe.

talk.title: Ikibaho cyo kuvuga
talk.lead: Kanda ku ishusho. Telefoni yerekana amagambo mu nyuguti nini kandi ikayavuga mu ijwi riranguruye.
talk.voiceOn: Telefoni yawe isoma amagambo mu ijwi riranguruye.
talk.voiceOff: Telefoni yawe nta jwi ifite ry'uru rurimi, bityo amagambo yerekanwa mu nyuguti nini.

learn.title: Kwiga
learn.lead: Buri nyandiko yerekana aho ivuye n'uko yasuzumwe.
learn.fellBack: Ntiraboneka mu rurimi rwawe, bityo yerekanwe mu Cyongereza.

visit.title: Ibibazo byo kubaza muganga
visit.lead: Andika cyangwa ufate amajwi y'ibibazo igihe ubitekereje.

voice.noMic: Mikoro ntiboneka. Reba uburenganzira bwa telefoni.

messages.title: Ubutumwa
messages.notice: Ubutumwa ntibukoreshwa mu bihe byihutirwa kandi ntibusomwa igihe cyose.

calendar.title: Ingengabihe y'ubuvuzi
calendar.lead: Ni nde ukora iki, n'inyandiko z'ukurikiraho.
calendar.empty: Nta kiteganyijwe mu minsi 30 iri imbere.

care.noPeople: Nta muntu urakugezaho amakuru ye. Saba uwo muntu kode ye.

alerts.urgent_answer: {name} yasubije Yego ku kibazo cyihutirwa cy'ikurikirana ({date}).
alerts.doses_not_marked: Imiti {count} ntiyanditswe ko yafashwe na {name} ejo.

caseload.title: Abarwayi bawe
caseload.factsOnly: Ibintu bifatika gusa: amatariki n'imibare uwo muntu yanditse. Nta manota y'ibyago, nta rutonde.

filter.no_check_in: Nta kurikirana mu minsi 2 cyangwa irenga

summary.title: Incamake
summary.disclaimer: Ibisobanuro by'ibyo uwo muntu yanditse. Si isuzuma ry'indwara kandi si inama y'ubuvuzi.
summary.urgentDays: Iminsi yasubijwe Yego ku kibazo cyihutirwa: {n}

templates.title: Ingero za gahunda
templates.lead: Intonde z'imirimo wongera gukoresha. Kongeraho imwe byandukura imirimo muri gahunda y'umuntu.
templates.name: Izina ry'urugero

chw.title: Gusura mu rugo
chw.empty: Nta muntu urakugezaho amakuru ye. Saba uwo muntu kode ye.

visitLog.lead: Ikora nta murandasi. Yoherezwa iyo wongeye kubona murandasi.
visitLog.readingHint: Gusa niba wapimye muri uru ruzinduko.

items.check_in_done: Nabajije ibibazo byo gukurikirana bya buri munsi
items.health_centre_advised: Nagiriye inama yo kujya ku kigo nderabuzima

sharing.title: Gusangiza
sharing.leadPatient: Uhitamo ubona amakuru yawe, kandi ushobora guhagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
sharing.label: Izina rye (si ngombwa)

scopes.caregiver: Ashobora kubona gahunda yawe, ibipimo, imiti n'ikurikirana, akongeraho ibipimo kandi akandika imirimo mu izina ryawe, akanakoresha ingengabihe n'ubutumwa.
scopes.clinician: Ashobora kubona amakuru yawe, akandika gahunda yawe yo gukira n'urutonde rw'imiti, akanandikira itsinda rikwitaho.
scopes.chw: Ashobora kubona amakuru yawe, gupima iyo agusuye mu rugo, kwandika uruzinduko, no gukoresha ingengabihe n'ubutumwa.

more.caregiver: Ashobora kandi kureba no kongeramo inyandiko y'ukugenda, intego n'interuro zawe bwite.
more.clinician: Ashobora kandi kureba inyandiko y'ukugenda n'intego zawe, no kwandika ibyiciro byawe byo gukira.
more.chw: Ashobora kandi kureba no kongeramo inyandiko y'ukugenda, intego n'interuro zawe bwite.

settings.title: Njye
settings.translationNote: Inyandiko z'Ikinyarwanda n'Igifaransa ni iz'agateganyo kugeza zisuzumwe n'umuntu uzivuga kavukire.
settings.deleteHint: Ibi bisiba konti yawe n'amakuru yose. Ntibishobora gusubizwa.
settings.deleteConfirm: Usibe burundu konti yawe n'amakuru yawe yose?
settings.notVerified: Konti yawe y'umunyamwuga itegereje kwemezwa n'umuyobozi.
settings.offlineCopy: Bika gahunda yanjye kuri iyi telefoni
settings.offlineCopyHint: Bigufasha kubona gahunda yawe, imiti, gahunda z'ubuvuzi n'interuro zawe nta murandasi. Bihora kuri iyi telefoni kugeza usohotse, bityo wabikora gusa kuri telefoni ari iyawe wenyine.
settings.offlineCopyRemoved: Ibyari byabitswe byakuwe kuri iyi telefoni.

offline.notice: Nta murandasi ufite. Ibyo wanditse birabikwa bikoherezwa nyuma.
offline.saved: Byabitswe kuri iyi telefoni. Bizoherezwa iyo ubonye murandasi.
offline.copyShown: Nta murandasi ufite. Hagaragajwe ibyabitswe ubushize kuri iyi telefoni.

recovery.title: Gukira kwanjye
recovery.lead: Icyiciro urimo, intego zawe n'uko ugenda biri hamwe.
recovery.range: Kuva ku wa {from} kugeza ku wa {to}
recovery.goalLead: Wifuza kuzashobora gukora iki? Andika ukoresheje amagambo yawe.

mobility.title: Kugenda
mobility.lead: Andika uko wagenze. Nta gipimo cyiza kibaho.
mobility.leadOther: Andika uko yagenze. Nta gipimo cyiza kibaho.

help.with_aid: Nkoresheje inkoni, igikoresho cyo gushingiraho cyangwa ikindi

progress.title: Ibyanditswe
progress.lead: Ibyanditswe uko iminsi igenda. Ni ibibarwa, si amanota.
progress.chart: Imirongo yerekana ibibarwa bya buri munsi. Imibare imwe iri mu mbonerahamwe iri hasi.

phase.title: Ibyiciro byo gukira
phase.lead: Tanga izina rya buri cyiciro cyo gukira cy'uyu muntu ukoresheje amagambo yawe. Icyiciro urimo kigaragara ku rupapuro rwe rwa Uyu munsi.
phase.name: Izina ry'icyiciro

team.title: Abankwitaho
team.lead: Aba bantu bashobora kureba amakuru yawe kuko wahisemo kuyasangiza.
team.none: Nta muntu uraboneka. Sangiza kode kugira ngo utumire umuntu.

doctor.people: Umuntu {n} aragusangiza amakuru | Abantu {n} baragusangiza amakuru
doctor.needsLead: Ibyo bivugiye ubwabo. Bashyizwe ku rutonde rukurikije amazina, si uko bakomeye.

reasons.urgent: Yasubije Yego ku kibazo cy'ingenzi muri iki cyumweru
reasons.no_check_in: Nta kurikirana mu minsi 2 cyangwa irenga

reminders.title: Ibikwibutsa
reminders.lead: Ibikwibutsa bigaragara muri porogaramu. Ubutumwa bwa SMS cyangwa amatangazo ya telefoni ntibirabaho.

phrases.title: Interuro zanjye bwite
phrases.lead: Ongeraho amagambo uyu muntu akenera cyane. Agaragara mbere ku kibaho cyo kuvuga.
